sprint_goal: Migrate customer profile data from PostgreSQL to MongoDB with zero downtime, ensuring data integrity, performance, and backward compatibility.

tasks.title: Design MongoDB schema for flexible country-specific data
tasks.description: Create a MongoDB document schema allowing per-country subfields (e.g., Japan My Number, EU VAT ID) without fixed columns. Ensure compatibility with existing API models.

tasks.title: Define data mapping between PostgreSQL and MongoDB
tasks.description: Establish mapping logic between existing PostgreSQL columns and MongoDB document attributes, including normalization of NULL columns and transformation logic for nested country data.

tasks.title: Implement CDC-based backfill process
tasks.description: Configure change data capture pipeline (Debezium or AWS DMS) to stream data from PostgreSQL to MongoDB, ensuring zero data loss and idempotent writes during backfill.

tasks.title: Develop dual-write mechanism for transitional period
tasks.description: Update API service to perform writes to both PostgreSQL and MongoDB during dual-write phase; implement transactional consistency checks and error logging.

tasks.title: Set up MongoDB indexes for performance optimization
tasks.description: Create compound and country-specific indexes in MongoDB to achieve <50ms read latency (p95). Include index validation and performance benchmarking.

tasks.title: Implement feature flag rollout for migration activation
tasks.description: Integrate feature flags (e.g., LaunchDarkly) to gradually route API traffic to MongoDB without downtime; monitor latency and errors during rollout.

tasks.title: Validate data parity between PostgreSQL and MongoDB
tasks.description: Develop and execute automated data validation script to compare all migrated records ensuring 100% data parity. Generate report before cutover.

tasks.title: Create rollback mechanism to revert to PostgreSQL
tasks.description: Implement automated rollback procedures and scripts that can redirect API reads/writes to PostgreSQL within one hour if MongoDB issues occur.

risks.description: data inconsistency during dual-write phase leading to record mismatches
risks.mitigation: Implement idempotent writes, compare row counts every 12 hours, and add integrity checks in CDC pipeline

risks.description: performance degradation on MongoDB due to inadequate indexing
risks.mitigation: Create compound indexes, execute load testing, optimize queries based on read-heavy access patterns

risks.description: CDC pipeline failure causing incomplete backfill
risks.mitigation: Add monitoring alerts, retry failed batches automatically, maintain detailed audit trail of migrated records
Automate database switch scripts and pre-test rollback plan in staging environment

risks.description: schema mismatch between API models and MongoDB documents
risks.mitigation: Integrate schema validation library and perform contract tests in CI pipeline

definition_of_done: CDC pipeline streams data with zero loss
MongoDB indexes validated for <50ms read latency
Data parity validation script reports 100% match
Rollback script verified within one hour execution window
All documentation and validation reports submitted and reviewed
